reason: Losing those two customers hurts, so maybe I take the free call and look at the 15 companies. Pay 1,500 for cold emails to buyers who have never shaken my hand? Not this month. My customers buy from me because they know me, and a cold message from some domain I don't own won't get me that.
objection: In wholesale nobody switches supplier because of a cold email. Meetings are easy to count, but I need orders, and a 30-minute call with a stranger is a long way from a pallet on a truck. Also, 45 meetings for a logistics company tells me nothing about distribution.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies they send are buyers I actually recognise as right for my products, and I can talk to a past client who is a distributor like me and got real orders, not just meetings, out of it.
